rv.q: The funniest flat-out comedy since 'One Man, Two Guv'nors'...laughs this plentiful and this good are rare indeed.

'The Comedy About A Bank Robbery' is the latest play by the bogglingly prolific and talented team behind 'The Play That Goes Wrong' (or more accurately the 'Play That Goes Wrong' franchise) and it’s their best and funniest work yet.
This lung-bustingly funny play is just what the therapist ordered.
It's a show that will have you on the edge of your seat: you'll be rocked by laughter, then held in suspense as they pull off another nail-biting effect.
It all adds up to one of those cheerfully defiant shows that refuse to let you not like it.
It’s the funniest play since Noises Off .
The Comedy About A Bank Robbery is an exceptional farce, and it makes for a simply joyous night at the theatre.
If you’re looking for a West End comedy where big laughs are guaranteed then this is the show for you.
This is an outstanding and redefining farce in every way.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre delivers a hilarious farce that critics find even funnier than their hit "The Play That Goes Wrong." The ambitious physical comedy, impressive set design, and relentless slapstick earn widespread praise and big laughs.
